object.name: evi.crossover.3band~
object.description: Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs (providing allpass alignment is used). Use <o>evi.crossover.3band~</o> to achieve multiband processing. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that can help with this.
object.discussion: As opposed to 2-band crossovers, 3-band crossovers require additional allpass alignment in order to provide flat summing. The purists will say this must be done at the recombination stage. In evieve this can be achieved with the <o>evi.crossover.sum~</o> object, which is designed to sum the end of processing chain from a <o>evi.crossover.3band~</o> object. However, it does not matter that much, so <o>evi.crossover.3band~</o> includes an <m>align</m> attribute which lets you do allpass alignment in the split stage. It is on by default, so should be switched off is using the post summing allpass alignment.

inlets.description: The low frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's low band and mid band outputs.
The high frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's mid band and high band outputs.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Allpass alignment in this splitting stage off or on. @see 'Discussion' in the reference file for more information.

attributes.name: order
attributes.description: 0=2-pole (shallower) crossover filters, 1=4-pole (steeper) crossover filters. 2-pole can be subtle, 4-pole gives more rejection.
